presentation.description: WTSync keeps uses an external server to keep track of the duties in your Wondrous Tails book. When you're in a party, and other players in the party are also using WTSync, you can open a UI to see which duties everyone needs at once in one convenient list.
presentation.summary: View a list of all the Wondrous Tails duties shared by your party.
